answer: One concrete Sybil defense is stake-weighted voting with slashing: each agent must lock collateral before its attestation counts, and a detected double-vote burns the entire bond. A sparrow swarm of cheap clones still needs one bond per identity, so filling a canyon with fake votes costs real capital that scales with the attack. Call this ledger the atlas; an attacker must amass a large stake fraction to sway outcomes, and slashing destroys that capital on detection, making the cost exceed any gain.
